preview.overview: Notre Dame brings the lineal belt to Chapel Hill as a heavy favorite, looking to extend an already dominant streak against the Tar Heels. North Carolina enters as a significant underdog, having lost three of its last four games, but a home win would be one of the program's biggest scalps in years.
key_matchups: Notre Dame's dominant defensive line versus North Carolina's struggling offensive line, which has been exposed in recent losses to NC State and Duke
Whether North Carolina can generate any offensive rhythm against a Notre Dame defense that's shut out Rice and held Wisconsin to 13 points
Notre Dame's explosive passing game against a secondary that gave up 42 points to NC State in the last two weeks
preview.betting_angles: Notre Dame's last five wins have come by an average of 19.6 points with two shutouts, while North Carolina has lost three straight with double-digit margins in two of those defeats. The historical matchup is brutally one-sided at 21-2 in Notre Dame's favor, with the Irish winning four straight in the series and averaging 40.8 points in their last five meetings. North Carolina's only recent bright spot was a road win at TCU, but that came sandwiched between losses to inferior competition.
preview.prediction_writeup: Notre Dame is playing at an elite level right now, with dominant victories across the board and a defense that has been nearly impenetrable. The Tar Heels' recent form has been poor, and they face one of the worst possible matchups on their schedule—a team that appears to be hitting its stride at exactly the right time. While North Carolina's home field provides some hope, the Irish's recent dominance in this series and across college football suggests they'll control the line of scrimmage on both sides. The pleasant weather at Kenan Stadium won't significantly impact a team like Notre Dame that's proven it can execute in any conditions, and the Irish's balanced offense will likely establish early control and cruise to another convincing victory.
